title: FLIGHT OF THE AMAZON QUEEN
subtitle: Interactive Binary Illusions, 1995 · the floppy version, freeware, on ScummVM 0.6.1's Queen engine
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its name. Other switches of 0.6.1: -g<scaler> (normal, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f for full screen, -m<volume> for the music, -s<volume> for the sound effects, -n for no subtitles.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: FOTAQ_Floppy/queen.1 from FOTAQ_Floppy.zip, the freeware release the ScummVM project distributes

controls: walk, or the verb in the panel
the default verb for what is under the pointer
_why: The second engine of the build, not SCUMM: Queen's own, with its verb panel and inventory. Held to a native g++ build frame by frame (gate-scummvm).
